one_sentence_positioning.value: UK AISI总结前沿AI安全框架的新兴实践，涵盖风险识别、风险缓解和治理三大领域的56项具体做法。

evidence.quote: This paper summarises current thinking from companies, governments, and researchers on how to write an effective safety framework. We outline three core areas of a safety framework - risk identification and assessment, risk mitigation, and governance - and identify emerging practices within each area.

value: 安全框架涵盖三大领域：风险识别与评估、风险缓解、治理，共13个组件56项新兴实践
能力阈值(Capability thresholds)是当前主流做法，用于监控风险和定义安全开发部署条件
自主性相关风险(autonomy-related risks)是多家公司重点跟踪的风险域之一
安全案例(Safety cases)正成为整合各类证据进行综合风险评估的框架
紧急响应程序和持续监控是治理领域的关键新兴实践

evidence.quote: Risk domains covered by currently published safety frameworks include: CBRN (Anthropic, OpenAI, Google DeepMind, Magic, Naver), machine learning R&D (Anthropic, OpenAI, Google DeepMind, Magic), autonomy-related risks (OpenAI, Google DeepMind, Magic; Naver), cybersecurity (OpenAI, Google DeepMind, Magic), and persuasion (OpenAI).
As safety frameworks are novel and rapidly developing, we hope that this paper can serve both as an overview of work to date and as a starting point for further discussion and innovation.

value: 安全框架组件与新兴实践体系

evidence.quote: We identify thirteen components of a safety framework across these three areas, based on the Frontier AI Safety Commitments (FAISCs) (DSIT, 2024). Within these components, we identify a total of 56 emerging practices
